blurb: L’Atelier Yaffe is a creative project space and cultural platform rooted in Portland, where art, community, and everyday life intersect. Functioning as both a physical venue and an evolving creative ecosystem, L’Atelier hosts a dynamic calendar of programming year-round - from creative workshops to film screenings, craft sessions, community gatherings and more.
